QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expand to `private_##member` by default, and to plain `member` only when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS yields the plain member name.
